parallels.note: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

translations.web: So they made way for her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.
translations.bsb: So they seized Athaliah as she reached the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.
translations.kjv: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.
translations.asv: So they made way for her; and she went by the way of the horses' entry to the king's house: and there was she slain.
